svg.title: Incomplete batched-candidate comparison
svg.desc: Three complete five-observation candidate cells changed generation speed by minus 0.89, plus 1.47 and minus 0.88 percent. The next cell showed plus 3.93 percent over only four completed observations, before a request failed. Both 32k-input cells were not reached. No complete cell met the minimum plus 5 percent speed criterion. Solid markers have five successful candidate observations; the hollow diamond has four and is incomplete after the next request failed. Missing cells were not reached. The +5% reference is only the minimum speed criterion, alongside within-run variation, correctness and required concurrency. No overall gain or candidate concurrency cost was measured.
